sources.title: SUPERNOVA: Eliciting General Reasoning in LLMs with Reinforcement ...
sources.snippet: Overview SuperNova trains large language models to improve general reasoning abilities across different types of problems The approach uses reinforcement learning combined with natural language instructions The method focuses on teaching models to reason better rather than just memorizing correct answers The training process involves rewarding the model when it produces correct reasoning steps ...
